name: Southeastern Butcher Supplies, Inc.
old_description: Visit Southeastern Butcher Supplies today for top-class meat processing equipment and butcher supplies. Whether you have a business that needs equipment that can turn a whole side of beef into hamburger patties or you're a deer hunter who needs a sausage stuffer and collagen casings for your own special venison sausage, we have what you need!
about:
Southeastern Butcher Supplies, Inc. operates from Pelham, Alabama, where it serves as a dealer for meat processing machinery and a supplier of related parts and consumables. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business stocks equipment from multiple manufacturers, offers replacement parts for various brands, and carries a range of processing supplies including seasonings, vacuum bags, casings, and butcher knives. No facility size or headcount figures are provided.

Customers include commercial meat processors that need equipment to break down whole sides of beef into patties, as well as individual hunters looking for sausage stuffers and collagen casings for venison. The company addresses both industrial and retail demand.

The company emphasizes its role as a single source for machinery, parts, and supplies, aiming to help customers find the right equipment and keep it running.
